name: Asakawa Naomi
source:
A gal with a great beauty. Her terrible personality does not suit her good looks. She has luscious golden brown skin.

She has a boyfriend, but when she meets Yuuki, she is lovestruck and decides to give her entire self to him.

She is extremely stubborn and can easily defeat the strongest men. While normally domineering, in front of the right man she turns into an obedient slave. She will do anything for the man she falls in love with.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180121082105/https://7thdoor.x.fc2.com/HP/7th_index.html]official site[/url]]
